description: Deterministic synthetic test fixtures for FlowForge AI Implementation 03 Support Ticket Intake workflow

valid_tickets.subject: Unable to access account dashboard
valid_tickets.body: Whenever I attempt to log into the customer portal, I am redirected to the login screen with a session timeout error.

valid_tickets.subject: Billing discrepancy on invoice INV-2026-089
valid_tickets.body: Our monthly subscription fee reflects an unexpected charge for extra seats that were de-provisioned last billing cycle.

valid_tickets.subject: Webhook delivery failure to endpoint
valid_tickets.body: Outbound webhooks for event type order.completed are returning HTTP 504 gateway timeout after 10 seconds.

valid_tickets.subject: API rate limit encountered during sync job
valid_tickets.body: Nightly batch synchronization job was throttled with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests at 02:15 UTC.

valid_tickets.subject: SSO authentication failure via SAML 2.0
valid_tickets.body: Employees attempting Okta SSO login are encountering an Invalid SAML Response error with assertion code 403.

valid_tickets.subject: CSV export contains corrupted UTF-8 characters
valid_tickets.body: When downloading customer audit logs as CSV, non-ASCII characters in names appear as question marks or mojibake.

valid_tickets.subject: Missing audit log events for deleted users
valid_tickets.body: Compliance review revealed that user de-provisioning events between Oct 10 and Oct 15 are absent from the audit trail.

valid_tickets.subject: Permission escalation issue in team workspace
valid_tickets.body: Standard team members can see administrative configuration tabs despite role-based access control restrictions.

valid_tickets.subject: Password reset email delivery delay
valid_tickets.body: Customers are reporting that verification and password reset emails are taking upwards of 45 minutes to arrive.

valid_tickets.subject: Mobile viewport rendering issue in notification center
valid_tickets.body: On iOS Safari viewports below 400px width, the notification drawer overlaps navigation controls preventing dismissal.

edge_cases.description: Submitting the exact same source_event_id, subject, and body returns the existing ticket with duplicate=true
Submitting an existing source_event_id with different subject/body content returns HTTP 409 conflict
